description.plain:
Friday, January 9, 2026 | 6:30 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN0000023tgL2AQ/
Kick off the new year by joining the Worcester 20s & 30s group for an evening of skiing/boarding at Mt. Wachusett on Friday, January 9th!We will be to there for Session 4 (7pm - 9:30pm), but we will plan to meet a half hour earlier at the lodge for introductions and coordination. Each participant is responsible for purchasing their own lift ticket.All levels are welcome. Once we get started, we expect groups to organically self-sort based on slopes of interest and level. The leaders are happy to ski with any group!
